messages.text: Forest latest: Pre-season rounded off with Brest win
Jacquet scores on debut as Liverpool beat Como

metadata.summary: Jeremy Jacquet was the star as Liverpool enjoyed a confidence-boosting 2-0 win over Como in their final pre-season friendly at Anfield.

messages.text: West Ham blow two-goal lead at Burnley to draw on Championship return

metadata.summary: Zian Flemming struck twice late on as Burnley came back to deny West Ham in a 2-2 Championship draw between the freshly relegated sides at Turf Moor.

messages.text: Middlesex stun Durham to deny Stokes spot in One-Day Cup final

metadata.summary: Ben Stokes and Durham were denied a spot in the 2026 Metro Bank One-Day Cup final as Middlesex pulled off a stunning, comeback clinch a first List-A final appearance for 36 years.

messages.text: Arsenal thump Man City to send statement with Community Shield win

metadata.summary: Title-holders Arsenal delivered a statement performance in the Community Shield, thumping Man City 3-0 in Cardiff to send out a warning to all of their Premier League rivals.

messages.text: Rayif roars back to his best to land Prix Jacques le Marois

metadata.summary: French 2000 Guineas hero Rayif bounced back to form to repel a strong raiding party in the Aga Khan Studs Prix Jacques le Marois at Deauville.

messages.text: Late DRAMA! Flemming's 90+2' strike snatches point for Burnley!

metadata.summary: Zian Flemming strikes again against West Ham as his second goal levels it up for Burnley.

messages.text: Winther pips fellow Dane Højgaard in thrilling finish

metadata.summary: Jeff Winther ended a four-year wait to claim his second DP World Tour title on Sunday at the Danish Golf Championship, pipping compatriot Rasmus Højgaard in a thrilling finish.

metadata.summary: Highlights of The Hundred Women’s Final between Trent Rockets and SunRisers Leeds.

messages.text: Musiala 'okay' after fainting during Bayern friendly
Scotland appoint Pocognoli as head coach

metadata.summary: Scotland have appointed Sebastien Pocognoli as their new head coach.

messages.text: Rockets demolish SunRisers to win women's Hundred title for first time

metadata.summary: Trent Rockets stormed to a first women's Hundred title after demolishing defending champions SunRisers Leeds by eight wickets in a one-sided final at Lord's.

messages.text: Southampton baited over Spygate scandal in defeat at Watford

metadata.summary: Southampton discovered that the Championship will be an unforgiving arena this season as they were baited about Spygate on their way to being beaten 2-1 by a new-look Watford side at Vicarage Road.

messages.text: Ronaldo: This is probably my last year of football

metadata.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has suggested that he will retire from football at the end of this season.

messages.text: Rangers, Hearts and Hibs through in League Cup as Stenhousemuir shock Motherwell

metadata.summary: Derek McInnes earned his first win as Rangers manager with a dominant 5-1 victory over holders St Mirren to advance to the quarter-finals of the Scottish League Cup, where they will meet rivals Celtic.
